title: One enzyme, one substrate level
q: In the ideal model v = Vmax·S/(Km + S), an enzyme has Vmax = 8 and Km = 2. What is its rate when S = 2?
why: At S = Km = 2, the rate is 8 × 2/(2 + 2) = 4, half the stated Vmax.

title: Adding substrate
q: In the model v = 6S/(2 + S), the rate at S = 1 is 2. What is the rate at S = 2?
why: At S = 2, v = 6 × 2/(2 + 2) = 3. The curve rises from 2 at S = 1 to 3 at S = 2.

title: A competitive inhibitor
q: In this ideal competitive-inhibition model, A has Vmax = 8 and Km = 2, while B has the same Vmax and apparent Km = 4. At S = 2, which rate is higher?
why: At S = 2, A is 4 and B is about 2.67. In this ideal competitive model the apparent Km changes while Vmax stays fixed.

title: A noncompetitive inhibitor
q: In this ideal pure noncompetitive model, A has Vmax = 8 and B has Vmax = 4; both have Km = 2. At S = 2, which rate is higher?
why: At S = 2, A is 4 and B is 2. In this ideal pure noncompetitive model Vmax changes while Km stays fixed.

title: Twice as much enzyme
q: In this ideal model, doubling active enzyme doubles Vmax from 8 in A to 16 in B while Km stays at 2. At S = 2, what is B's rate?
why: At S = 2, B's rate is 16 × 2/(2 + 2) = 8; A's rate is 4. This model holds other conditions fixed.

title: Same maximum, different Km
q: Two ideal enzyme curves have the same Vmax = 6. Curve A has Km = 1 and B has Km = 2. At S = 2, which rate is higher?
why: At S = 2, A gives 4 and B gives 3. With the same Vmax, the smaller Km curve is higher at this positive substrate level.

title: Two matching enzymes
q: Two ideal curves both have Vmax = 6 and Km = 1. At S = 2, how do their predicted rates compare?
why: Both curves calculate 6 × 2/(1 + 2) = 4 at S = 2. Identical parameters give identical predictions in this model.

title: Two advantages compete
q: Curve A has Vmax = 6 and Km = 1; B has Vmax = 9 and Km = 2. Under v = Vmax·S/(Km + S), which rate is higher at S = 2?
why: At S = 2, A gives 4 while B gives 4.5. Comparing a higher Vmax and a higher Km requires checking the substrate level.
